comparison.objective: Loosen a captive nut and open a latch arm; candidate extracts a reusable terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: Select and fit a wrench, rotate a nut, and swing an arm versus insert a narrow extraction tool, depress an internal retainer, and withdraw a terminal.
comparison.success_condition: Nut backed off and arm open without rounding or excess force versus correct terminal removed with reusable parts and adjacent contacts retained. Candidate numeric limits are absent.
comparison.reason: Both use a tool to release something, but rotary fastener operation and arm opening are meaningfully different from hidden retention-lance extraction.
